result.summary: out of scope — no executable surface produced by this fix (build-config-only: web/package.json's type-check script value change from `tsc --noEmit` to `tsc -b tsconfig.json`). Per WF-02 Step 3's explicit exemption, project/build configuration (mix.exs aliases/deps declarations, .formatter.exs, and by direct analogy an npm script value in package.json) is 'in the same nothing to unit-test category as decision-record prose -- it's verified by actually running the command it declares, not by an ExUnit test asserting on its own declaration.' There is no ExUnit/vitest-exercisable logic in a script string; the only real verification is running `npm run type-check` itself, which Step 3 already did. Independently reviewed handoffs/WF03-ISS0274-20260822/step-03-frontend-dev.json's quoted evidence and confirm it is a genuine, adequate fail-then-pass regression proof, not a fabricated one: (1) `npx tsc -b tsconfig.json --listFiles` walked 964 real files, proving the new script does real compilation work versus the old script's silent 0-file no-op; (2) a deliberate type error was injected into web/src/main.tsx (`const __iss0274_deliberate_type_error: number = 'not a number'`), `npm run type-check` failed with `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'` at exit code 2; (3) the injected line was reverted (confirmed via `git diff --stat src/main.tsx` showing zero diff), and `npm run type-check` passed again at exit 0; (4) `npm run build` and the combined `npm run check` gate (type-check + lint + 178 vitest unit tests + 48 guard tests) both remained green post-fix. This satisfies the fail-then-pass requirement in genuine command-output form, the substitute WF-02 Step 3 anticipates for build-config-only changes -- no additional test file is warranted and writing one (e.g. a script/grep-based test asserting on the package.json string) would be exactly the manufactured-busywork anti-pattern core-directives.md and WF-02 Step 3 both warn against, since it would test the declaration rather than any real behavior.
result.next_action: Route directly to Step 5 (ISSUE-FIXER closes the issue) -- Steps 4b/4c (TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR/TEST-RUNNER) skipped per WF-02 Step 3's scope-test-NO precedent, same as the WF03-ISS0273 handling pattern for build-config-only changes.
